gaps.requirement: Section 7 'Guide completeness: 100% of critical how-to guides have prerequisites, expected result, failure route (automated content checklist)' and section 8 item 2 (standardise six critical guides).
gaps.current: No notion of 'critical' exists: grep -ri critical over scripts/, tests/, data/, AGENTS.md and DESIGN.md finds nothing. guides.py only checks a lead paragraph and a first H1 (describe at guides.py:96, heading_title at :193). Imported guides have no metadata channel (title = first '# ', description = opening paragraph), so chips or front matter cannot be used. guides.py is 258 of 300 allowed lines, so a checker cannot go inside it.
gaps.proposal: Proportionate standard = a heading convention, not a rewrite or a template. For guides listed under a new top-level key `critical:` in data/guides.yaml (slugs: install, initialise-repository, notebook-requirements, notebook-upload, executable-creation; plus the /submit/ page checked from content/submit.md), require: (a) a lead paragraph (already enforced); (b) H2 `What you need` (or `Before you start`); (c) H2 `Check that it worked`; (d) H2 `If something does not work` (the plugin guides' existing wording); (e) H2 `Next`. Time is a sentence in the lead paragraph (e.g. 'about 10 minutes of your time, plus 15 minutes of build waiting'), checked by a regex for 'minute' on critical guides only. Implement as a pure function `missing_sections(markdown) -> list[str]` in a new scripts/lcsite/guide_shape.py, called from write_template_guide / write_source_guide / write_own; it calls fail() naming the file and the missing heading (no silent fallback). Add tests/test_guide_shape.py with the failing case. Land it only after the template PR (G2) is merged, because the daily build reads the template's main (AGENTS.md: do not push to main before dependent PRs merge). Optionally extend to the three plugin guides later (they already have 2 of 4 headings).
